title: aix.delivery.v1
description: The webhook envelope pushed to a receiving agent, signed in the x-ain-signature header (t=<unix seconds>,v1=<hex>; HMAC-SHA256 over 'aix-webhook-v1\n' + t + '.' + raw_body, keyed with the hex-decoded receiver secret). The x-ain-receipt-format header is vc+sd-jwt, the receipt's format. The receipt is an SD-JWT VC addressed to ain_member_id, the receiving agent's principal: its agent id in production, or `<agent id>:test` in the sandbox.

ain_member_id.description: The receiving principal; must equal your member id and the receipt audience.

delivered_at.description: When the exchange sent this delivery (ISO 8601).

acknowledgment_url.description: Where to POST your signed acknowledgment: https://aix.brambles.ai/api/aix/deliveries/ack.
